      "title": "A line saying that a blocking period ended stays on the steward's situation page forever, and in every steward brief. Background: the claim quota allows this machine one claimed goal at a time. A blocking period (an 'occurrence') is the stretch during which that held goal keeps ready priority-1 work waiting. Each period gets a start line and an end line in claim-quota.jsonl. When a period ends, the page now shows 'the occurrence ended: <goal> <cause>' in the program part's summary, and nothing ever removes that line. Each goal that ever ended a period adds one summary line, whether it is long concluded or was released last month. The only exception is a goal that is blocking again at that moment. The summary is the default view and is copied into every seat steward's brief. Within days of normal use (the brief's own receipts show two to three different holders in one day), the page and the agent's brief fill with closed history. That goes against D13's 'one line per occurrence' for current blocking and against the summary-by-default rule. The brief asks for the line to report that a period ended. It does not ask for that report to last forever."
